title: Podman 6.1.3 macOS ARM64 installer: checksum matches, but signature verification fails
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/discussions/29895
Originally posted by **vscara3-arch** October 3, 2026 I’m trying to install Podman 6.1.3 on an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26.5. The installer’s SHA256 matches the published release checksum, but pkgutil :check-signature returns “Status: invalid signature” with exit code 1. Installation is stopped. Is this a known issue, and what official diagnostic should I use to check the package’s signature and notarization without bypassing security checks????

The retained observation was recorded at 2026-10-02T12:13:28.625211+00:00 after the actual command; the exact invocation time was not separately captured. The retained checksum checks matched the published release digest and manifest at that time. This is historical evidence, not a fresh signature test or current release verification. Matching hashes do not establish trusted signing. The output identified no signer or certificate chain; the cause and notarization status remain unknown. Package inspection stopped, and no installation, extraction, signature retry or security override followed in that recorded task.

What specific supported, read-only, non-bypass diagnostic and minimal output would distinguish a package-signing/notarization problem from a local verification/trust limitation for this exact asset? Please specify any network, trust-store or system changes it would require. I am requesting guidance only; a diagnostic, download or installation would need separate review before execution. I cannot substantiate an OS version from the retained local evidence above.
